title: Global existence for a Fritz John equation in expanding FLRW spacetimes
summary: We study the family of semilinear wave equations $\square_{\mathbf{g}_p}φ=(\partial_tφ)^2$, on fixed expanding FLRW spacetimes, having $\mathbb{R}^3$ spatial slices and undergoing a power law expansion, with scale factor $a(t)=t^p$, $0 1$) and relied on the integrability of the inverse of the scale factor to establish future global well-posedness. In the current work, where such an integrability condition is lacking, we rely on a vector field method that captures and combines dispersive estimates with the spacetime expansion to control the solution and suppress the nonlinear blow-up…
